<?php

namespace App\Filament\Widgets;

use App\Enums\ActivityType;
use App\Models\Activity;
use Filament\Support\Colors\Color;
use Filament\Support\RawJs;
use Filament\Widgets\ChartWidget;
use Filament\Widgets\Concerns\InteractsWithPageFilters;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;

/**
 * Ripartizione percentuale delle attività per tipo,
 * filtrata per il periodo selezionato in dashboard.
 *
 * Colori ed etichette arrivano da ActivityType, la stessa fonte
 * usata dal badge "Tipo" nella tabella attività, per restare coerenti
 * in tutto il pannello.
 */
class ActivityTypesChartWidget extends ChartWidget
{
    use InteractsWithPageFilters;

    protected static ?string $heading = 'Tipi di attività';

    protected static ?int $sort = 0;

    protected static ?string $maxHeight = '320px';

    /**
     * Oltre le fette più grandi il resto viene accorpato in "Altro",
     * altrimenti una torta con troppe fette diventa illeggibile.
     */
    private const MAX_SLICES = 7;

    protected function getType(): string
    {
        return 'pie';
    }

    protected function getData(): array
    {
        $slices = $this->getSlices();

        if ($slices->isEmpty()) {
            return [
                'datasets' => [['data' => []]],
                'labels' => [],
            ];
        }

        return [
            'datasets' => [
                [
                    'label' => 'Attività',
                    'data' => $slices->pluck('total')->all(),
                    'backgroundColor' => $slices->pluck('color')->all(),
                    // bordo trasparente = 2px di superficie fra le fette, in entrambi i temi
                    'borderColor' => 'transparent',
                    'borderWidth' => 2,
                ],
            ],
            'labels' => $slices->pluck('label')->all(),
        ];
    }

    protected function getOptions(): RawJs
    {
        return RawJs::make(<<<'JS'
            {
                plugins: {
                    legend: {
                        position: 'right',
                        labels: {
                            boxWidth: 12,
                            boxHeight: 12,
                            usePointStyle: true,
                            pointStyle: 'circle',
                        },
                    },
                    tooltip: {
                        callbacks: {
                            label: (context) => {
                                const total = context.dataset.data.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
                                const percentage = total ? (context.parsed / total * 100) : 0;

                                return ` ${context.label}: ${context.parsed} (${percentage.toFixed(1)}%)`;
                            },
                        },
                    },
                },
            }
        JS);
    }

    /**
     * Una riga per fetta: totale, etichetta e colore risolti da ActivityType.
     * Oltre MAX_SLICES le code vengono accorpate in "Altro".
     *
     * @return Collection<int, array{total: int, label: string, color: string}>
     */
    private function getSlices(): Collection
    {
        $counts = Activity::query()
            ->where('user_id', auth()->id())
            ->when(
                $this->filters['startDate'] ?? null,
                fn (Builder $query, $date) => $query->whereDate('start_date_local', '>=', $date)
            )
            ->when(
                $this->filters['endDate'] ?? null,
                fn (Builder $query, $date) => $query->whereDate('start_date_local', '<=', $date)
            )
            ->selectRaw('type, COUNT(*) as total')
            ->groupBy('type')
            ->pluck('total', 'type')
            ->sortDesc();

        $slices = $counts->map(function (int $total, ?string $type) {
            $activityType = $type !== null ? ActivityType::tryFrom($type) : null;

            return [
                'total' => $total,
                'label' => $activityType?->getLabel() ?? 'Sconosciuto',
                'color' => $this->colorToRgb($activityType?->getColor() ?? Color::Gray),
            ];
        })->values();

        if ($slices->count() <= self::MAX_SLICES) {
            return $slices;
        }

        return $slices
            ->take(self::MAX_SLICES)
            ->push([
                'total' => $slices->slice(self::MAX_SLICES)->sum('total'),
                'label' => 'Altro',
                'color' => $this->colorToRgb(Color::Gray),
            ]);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<int, string>  $color
     */
    private function colorToRgb(array $color): string
    {
        return "rgb({$color[500]})";
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Filament\Widgets;

use App\Enums\ActivityType;
use App\Models\Activity;
use Filament\Support\Colors\Color;
use Filament\Support\RawJs;
use Filament\Widgets\ChartWidget;
use Filament\Widgets\Concerns\InteractsWithPageFilters;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;

/**
 * Km totali percorsi per tipo di attività,
 * filtrati per il periodo selezionato in dashboard.
 *
 * Colori ed etichette arrivano da ActivityType, la stessa fonte
 * usata dal badge "Tipo" e dal grafico a torta, per restare coerenti
 * in tutto il pannello.
 */
class DistanceByTypeChartWidget extends ChartWidget
{
    use InteractsWithPageFilters;

    protected static ?string $heading = 'Km per tipo di attività';

    protected static ?int $sort = 0;

    protected static ?string $maxHeight = '320px';

    /**
     * Oltre le barre più grandi il resto viene accorpato in "Altro".
     */
    private const MAX_BARS = 7;

    protected function getType(): string
    {
        return 'bar';
    }

    protected function getData(): array
    {
        $bars = $this->getBars();

        if ($bars->isEmpty()) {
            return [
                'datasets' => [['data' => []]],
                'labels' => [],
            ];
        }

        return [
            'datasets' => [
                [
                    'label' => 'Km totali',
                    'data' => $bars->pluck('km')->all(),
                    'backgroundColor' => $bars->pluck('color')->all(),
                ],
            ],
            'labels' => $bars->pluck('label')->all(),
        ];
    }

    protected function getOptions(): RawJs
    {
        return RawJs::make(<<<'JS'
            {
                indexAxis: 'y',
                scales: {
                    x: {
                        beginAtZero: true,
                    },
                    y: {
                        ticks: {
                            // km totale già visibile sull'etichetta della barra
                            callback: function (value, index) {
                                const label = this.getLabelForValue(value);
                                const km = this.chart.data.datasets[0].data[index];

                                return `${label} — ${km.toLocaleString('it-IT')} km`;
                            },
                        },
                    },
                },
                plugins: {
                    legend: {
                        display: false,
                    },
                    tooltip: {
                        callbacks: {
                            label: (context) => ` ${context.parsed.x.toLocaleString('it-IT')} km`,
                        },
                    },
                },
            }
        JS);
    }

    /**
     * Una riga per barra: km totali, etichetta e colore risolti da ActivityType.
     * Oltre MAX_BARS le code vengono accorpate in "Altro".
     *
     * @return Collection<int, array{km: float, label: string, color: string}>
     */
    private function getBars(): Collection
    {
        $totals = Activity::query()
            ->where('user_id', auth()->id())
            ->when(
                $this->filters['startDate'] ?? null,
                fn (Builder $query, $date) => $query->whereDate('start_date_local', '>=', $date)
            )
            ->when(
                $this->filters['endDate'] ?? null,
                fn (Builder $query, $date) => $query->whereDate('start_date_local', '<=', $date)
            )
            ->selectRaw('type, COALESCE(SUM(distance), 0) as total')
            ->groupBy('type')
            ->pluck('total', 'type')
            ->sortDesc();

        $bars = $totals->map(function (mixed $total, ?string $type) {
            $activityType = $type !== null ? ActivityType::tryFrom($type) : null;

            return [
                'km' => round(((float) $total) / 1000, 1),
                'label' => $activityType?->getLabel() ?? 'Sconosciuto',
                'color' => $this->colorToRgb($activityType?->getColor() ?? Color::Gray),
            ];
        })->values();

        if ($bars->count() <= self::MAX_BARS) {
            return $bars;
        }

        return $bars
            ->take(self::MAX_BARS)
            ->push([
                'km' => round($bars->slice(self::MAX_BARS)->sum('km'), 1),
                'label' => 'Altro',
                'color' => $this->colorToRgb(Color::Gray),
            ]);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<int, string>  $color
     */
    private function colorToRgb(array $color): string
    {
        return "rgb({$color[500]})";
    }
}

/**
 * Dislivello totale per tipo di attività,
 * filtrato per il periodo selezionato in dashboard.
 *
 * Colori ed etichette arrivano da ActivityType, la stessa fonte
 * usata dal badge "Tipo" e dagli altri grafici, per restare coerenti
 * in tutto il pannello.
 */
class ElevationByTypeChartWidget extends ChartWidget
{
    use InteractsWithPageFilters;

    protected static ?string $heading = 'Dislivello per tipo di attività';

    protected static ?int $sort = 0;

    protected static ?string $maxHeight = '320px';

    /**
     * Oltre le barre più grandi il resto viene accorpato in "Altro".
     */
    private const MAX_BARS = 7;

    protected function getType(): string
    {
        return 'bar';
    }

    protected function getData(): array
    {
        $bars = $this->getBars();

        if ($bars->isEmpty()) {
            return [
                'datasets' => [['data' => []]],
                'labels' => [],
            ];
        }

        return [
            'datasets' => [
                [
                    'label' => 'Dislivello totale',
                    'data' => $bars->pluck('meters')->all(),
                    'backgroundColor' => $bars->pluck('color')->all(),
                ],
            ],
            'labels' => $bars->pluck('label')->all(),
        ];
    }

    protected function getOptions(): RawJs
    {
        return RawJs::make(<<<'JS'
            {
                indexAxis: 'y',
                scales: {
                    x: {
                        beginAtZero: true,
                    },
                    y: {
                        ticks: {
                            // dislivello totale già visibile sull'etichetta della barra
                            callback: function (value, index) {
                                const label = this.getLabelForValue(value);
                                const meters = this.chart.data.datasets[0].data[index];

                                return `${label} — ${meters.toLocaleString('it-IT')} m`;
                            },
                        },
                    },
                },
                plugins: {
                    legend: {
                        display: false,
                    },
                    tooltip: {
                        callbacks: {
                            label: (context) => ` ${context.parsed.x.toLocaleString('it-IT')} m`,
                        },
                    },
                },
            }
        JS);
    }

    /**
     * Una riga per barra: dislivello totale, etichetta e colore risolti da ActivityType.
     * Oltre MAX_BARS le code vengono accorpate in "Altro".
     *
     * @return Collection<int, array{meters: int, label: string, color: string}>

    {
        $totals = Activity::query()
            ->where('user_id', auth()->id())
            ->when(
                $this->filters['startDate'] ?? null,

            ->groupBy('type')
            ->pluck('total', 'type')
            ->sortDesc();

        $bars = $totals->map(function (mixed $total, ?string $type) {
            $activityType = $type !== null ? ActivityType::tryFrom($type) : null;

            return [
                'meters' => (int) $total,
                'label' => $activityType?->getLabel() ?? 'Sconosciuto',
                'color' => $this->colorToRgb($activityType?->getColor() ?? Color::Gray),
            ];
        })->values();

        if ($bars->count() <= self::MAX_BARS) {
            return $bars;
        }

        return $bars
            ->take(self::MAX_BARS)
            ->push([
                'meters' => (int) $bars->slice(self::MAX_BARS)->sum('meters'),
                'label' => 'Altro',
                'color' => $this->colorToRgb(Color::Gray),
            ]);
    }

    /**

/**

 */
class Dashboard extends BaseDashboard
{
    use HasFiltersForm;

    /**
     * Filament applica il default di un campo solo al primissimo fill "da zero":
     * se la sessione contiene già un filtro esplicito (anche vuoto, salvato prima
     * che questi default esistessero), il default non scatta più. Qui forziamo
     * i valori pre-calcolati ogni volta che entrambi i campi risultano vuoti.
     */
    public function mount(): void
    {
        if (filled($this->filters['startDate'] ?? null) || filled($this->filters['endDate'] ?? null)) {
            return;
        }

        $range = $this->getUserActivitiesDateRange();

        $this->filters['startDate'] = $range->min;
        $this->filters['endDate'] = $range->max;

        $this->getFiltersForm()->fill($this->filters);

        if ($this->persistsFiltersInSession()) {
            session()->put($this->getFiltersSessionKey(), $this->filters);
        }
    }

    public function filtersForm(Form $form): Form
    {
        return $form
            ->schema([
                DatePicker::make('startDate')
                    ->label('Data inizio')
                    ->default(fn () => $this->getUserActivitiesDateRange()->min)
                    ->maxDate(fn (callable $get) => $get('endDate') ?: now()),

                DatePicker::make('endDate')
                    ->label('Data fine')
                    ->default(fn () => $this->getUserActivitiesDateRange()->max)
                    ->minDate(fn (callable $get) => $get('startDate'))
                    ->maxDate(now())
                    ->suffixAction(
                        Action::make('reset')
                            ->label('Reimposta')
                            ->icon('heroicon-m-arrow-path')
                            ->action(function (Set $set) {
                                $range = $this->getUserActivitiesDateRange();

                                $set('startDate', Carbon::parse($range->min)->toDateString());
                                $set('endDate', Carbon::parse($range->max)->toDateString());
                            }),
                        isInline: true,
                    ),
            ])
            ->columns(2);
    }

    /**
     * Data della prima e dell'ultima attività registrata dall'utente,
     * usate come estremi preimpostati del filtro periodo.
     */
    protected function getUserActivitiesDateRange(): object
    {
        return once(fn () => Activity::query()
            ->where('user_id', auth()->id())
            ->selectRaw('min(start_date_local) as min, max(start_date_local) as max')
            ->first());
    }
}

     * @return array{0: string, 1: string}
     */
    protected function getPresetRange(string $preset): array
    {
        $now = Carbon::now();

        return match ($preset) {
            // la settimana comincia di domenica
            'current_week' => [
                $now->copy()->startOfWeek(Carbon::SUNDAY)->toDateString(),
                $now->copy()->startOfWeek(Carbon::SUNDAY)->addDays(6)->toDateString(),
            ],
            'current_month' => [
                $now->copy()->startOfMonth()->toDateString(),
                $now->copy()->endOfMonth()->toDateString(),
            ],
            'current_year' => [
                $now->copy()->startOfYear()->toDateString(),
                $now->copy()->endOfYear()->toDateString(),
            ],
            'last_7_days' => [
                $now->copy()->subDays(6)->toDateString(),
                $now->toDateString(),
            ],
            'last_30_days' => [
                $now->copy()->subDays(29)->toDateString(),
                $now->toDateString(),
            ],
            'last_year' => [
                $now->copy()->subYear()->addDay()->toDateString(),
                $now->toDateString(),
            ],
        };
    }

    /**
     * Data della prima e dell'ultima attività registrata dall'utente,
     * usate come estremi preimpostati del filtro periodo.
     */
    protected function getUserActivitiesDateRange(): object
    {
        return once(fn () => Activity::query()
            ->where('user_id', auth()->id())
            ->selectRaw('min(start_date_local) as min, max(start_date_local) as max')
            ->first());
    }
}

namespace Filament\Tables\Actions;

use Closure;

{
    protected ?Closure $mutateRecordDataUsing = null;

    public static function getDefaultName(): ?string
    {
        return 'view';
    }

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->label(__('filament-actions::view.single.label'));

        $this->modalHeading(fn (): string => __('filament-actions::view.single.modal.heading', ['label' => $this->getRecordTitle()]));

        $this->modalSubmitAction(false);
        $this->modalCancelAction(fn (StaticAction $action) => $action->label(__('filament-actions::view.single.modal.actions.close.label')));

        $this->defaultColor('gray');

        $this->icon(FilamentIcon::resolve('actions::view-action') ?? 'heroicon-m-eye');

        $this->disabledForm();

        $this->fillForm(function (Model $record, Table $table): array {
            if ($translatableContentDriver = $table->makeTranslatableContentDriver()) {
                $data = $translatableContentDriver->getRecordAttributesToArray($record);
            } else {
                $data = $record->attributesToArray();
            }

            if ($this->mutateRecordDataUsing) {
                $data = $this->evaluate($this->mutateRecordDataUsing, ['data' => $data]);
            }

            return $data;
        });

        $this->action(static function (): void {});
    }

    public function mutateRecordDataUsing(?Closure $callback): static
    {
        $this->mutateRecordDataUsing = $callback;

        return $this;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Filament\Widgets;

use App\Enums\SpeedUnit;
use App\Models\Activity;
use Filament\Tables;
use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Widgets\Concerns\InteractsWithPageFilters;
use Filament\Widgets\TableWidget as BaseWidget;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;

/**
 * Elenco paginato delle attività dell'utente loggato,
 * filtrato per il periodo selezionato in dashboard.
 */
class ActivitiesTableWidget extends BaseWidget
{
    use InteractsWithPageFilters;

    protected static ?string $heading = 'Attività';

    protected int|string|array $columnSpan = 'full';

    protected static ?int $sort = 1;

    public function table(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->query($this->getActivitiesQuery())
            ->defaultSort('start_date_local', 'desc')
            ->paginated([10, 25, 50, 100])
            ->defaultPaginationPageOption(10)
            ->columns([
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('start_date_local')
                    ->label('Data')
                    ->dateTime('d/m/Y H:i')
                    ->sortable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('name')
                    ->label('Nome')
                    ->searchable()
                    ->wrap(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('type')
                    ->label('Tipo')
                    // colore ed etichetta arrivano da ActivityType (HasColor/HasLabel)
                    ->badge()
                    ->sortable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('distance')
                    ->label('Distanza')
                    // i metri arrivano da Strava, li mostro in km
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?int $state): string => number_format(($state ?? 0) / 1000, 2, ',', '.').' km')
                    ->alignEnd()
                    ->sortable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('moving_time')
                    ->label('Tempo')
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?int $state): string => gmdate($state >= 3600 ? 'H:i:s' : 'i:s', (int) $state))
                    ->alignEnd()
                    ->sortable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('total_elevation_gain')
                    ->label('Dislivello')
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?int $state): string => number_format((int) $state, 0, ',', '.').' m')
                    ->alignEnd()
                    ->sortable()
                    ->toggleable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('average_speed')
                    ->label('Vel. media')
                    // unità dipendente dal tipo (passo per le attività a piedi, km/h per le altre)
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?float $state, Activity $record): string => $record->type?->formatSpeed($state)
                        ?? SpeedUnit::KilometersPerHour->format($state))
                    ->alignEnd()
                    ->sortable()
                    ->toggleable(),
            ]);
    }

    protected function getActivitiesQuery(): Builder
    {
        return Activity::query()
            ->where('user_id', auth()->id())
            ->when(
                $this->filters['startDate'] ?? null,
                fn (Builder $query, $date) => $query->whereDate('start_date_local', '>=', $date)
            )
            ->when(
                $this->filters['endDate'] ?? null,
                fn (Builder $query, $date) => $query->whereDate('start_date_local', '<=', $date)
            );
    }
}

<?php

namespace Filament\Actions\Concerns;

use Closure;
use Filament\Actions\Contracts\HasRecord;
use Filament\Infolists\Components\Component;
use Filament\Infolists\Infolist;

trait HasInfolist
{
    /**
     * @var array<Component> | Closure | null
     */
    protected array | Closure | null $infolist = null;

    /**
     * @param  array<Component> | Closure | null  $infolist
     */
    public function infolist(array | Closure | null $infolist): static
    {
        $this->infolist = $infolist;

        return $this;
    }

    public function getInfolist(): ?Infolist
    {
        $infolistName = $this->getInfolistName();

        if (blank($infolistName)) {
            return null;
        }

        $infolist = Infolist::make($this->getLivewire())
            ->name($infolistName);

        if ($this instanceof HasRecord) {
            $infolist->record($this->getRecord());
        }

        $modifiedInfolist = $this->evaluate($this->infolist, [
            'infolist' => $infolist,
        ]);

        if ($modifiedInfolist === null) {
            return null;
        }

        if (is_array($modifiedInfolist) && (! count($modifiedInfolist))) {
            return null;
        }

        if (is_array($modifiedInfolist)) {
            $modifiedInfolist = $infolist->schema($modifiedInfolist);
        }

        return $modifiedInfolist;
    }

    public function getInfolistName(): ?string
    {
        return null;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Filament\Pages;

use App\Models\Activity;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Forms\Components\DatePicker;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use Filament\Forms\Form;
use Filament\Forms\Set;
use Filament\Pages\Dashboard as BaseDashboard;
use Filament\Pages\Dashboard\Concerns\HasFiltersForm;

/**
 * Dashboard con filtro per periodo, condiviso da tutti i widget.
 */
class Dashboard extends BaseDashboard
{
    use HasFiltersForm;

    /**
     * Filament applica il default di un campo solo al primissimo fill "da zero":
     * se la sessione contiene già un filtro esplicito (anche vuoto, salvato prima
     * che questi default esistessero), il default non scatta più. Qui forziamo
     * i valori pre-calcolati ogni volta che entrambi i campi risultano vuoti.
     */
    public function mount(): void
    {
        if (filled($this->filters['startDate'] ?? null) || filled($this->filters['endDate'] ?? null)) {
            return;
        }

        $range = $this->getUserActivitiesDateRange();

        $this->filters['startDate'] = $range->min;
        $this->filters['endDate'] = $range->max;

        $this->getFiltersForm()->fill($this->filters);

        if ($this->persistsFiltersInSession()) {
            session()->put($this->getFiltersSessionKey(), $this->filters);
        }
    }

    public function filtersForm(Form $form): Form
    {
        return $form
            ->schema([
                Select::make('preset')
                    ->label('Periodo rapido')
                    ->placeholder('Personalizzato')
                    ->options([
                        'current_week' => 'Settimana corrente',
                        'current_month' => 'Mese corrente',
                        'current_year' => 'Anno corrente',
                        'last_7_days' => 'Ultimi 7 giorni',
                        'last_30_days' => 'Ultimi 30 giorni',
                        'last_year' => 'Ultimo anno',
                    ])
                    ->live()
                    ->afterStateUpdated(function (?string $state, Set $set) {
                        if ($state === null) {
                            return;
                        }

                        [$start, $end] = $this->getPresetRange($state);

                        $set('startDate', $start);
                        $set('endDate', $end);
                    })
                    ->columnSpanFull(),

                DatePicker::make('startDate')
                    ->label('Data inizio')
                    ->default(fn () => $this->getUserActivitiesDateRange()->min)
                    ->maxDate(fn (callable $get) => $get('endDate') ?: now())
                    // modifica manuale = non è più uno dei preset rapidi
                    ->afterStateUpdated(fn (Set $set) => $set('preset', null))
                    ->live(),

                DatePicker::make('endDate')
                    ->label('Data fine')
                    ->default(fn () => $this->getUserActivitiesDateRange()->max)
                    ->minDate(fn (callable $get) => $get('startDate'))
                    ->maxDate(now())
                    ->afterStateUpdated(fn (Set $set) => $set('preset', null))
                    ->live()
                    ->suffixAction(
                        Action::make('reset')
                            ->label('Reimposta')
                            ->icon('heroicon-m-arrow-path')
                            ->action(function (Set $set) {
                                $range = $this->getUserActivitiesDateRange();

                                $set('preset', null);
                                $set('startDate', Carbon::parse($range->min)->toDateString());
                                $set('endDate', Carbon::parse($range->max)->toDateString());
                            }),
                        isInline: true,
                    ),
            ])
            ->columns(2);
    }

    /**
     * Estremi (data inizio, data fine) di un preset rapido.
     *
     * @return array{0: string, 1: string}
     */
    protected function getPresetRange(string $preset): array
    {
        $now = Carbon::now();

        return match ($preset) {
            // la settimana comincia di domenica
            'current_week' => [
                $now->copy()->startOfWeek(Carbon::SUNDAY)->toDateString(),
                $now->copy()->startOfWeek(Carbon::SUNDAY)->addDays(6)->toDateString(),
            ],
            'current_month' => [
                $now->copy()->startOfMonth()->toDateString(),
                $now->copy()->endOfMonth()->toDateString(),
            ],
            'current_year' => [
                $now->copy()->startOfYear()->toDateString(),
                $now->copy()->endOfYear()->toDateString(),
            ],
            'last_7_days' => [
                $now->copy()->subDays(6)->toDateString(),
                $now->toDateString(),
            ],
            'last_30_days' => [
                $now->copy()->subDays(29)->toDateString(),
                $now->toDateString(),
            ],
            'last_year' => [
                $now->copy()->subYear()->addDay()->toDateString(),
                $now->toDateString(),
            ],
        };
    }

    /**
     * Data della prima e dell'ultima attività registrata dall'utente,
     * usate come estremi preimpostati del filtro periodo.
     */
    protected function getUserActivitiesDateRange(): object
    {
        return once(fn () => Activity::query()
            ->where('user_id', auth()->id())
            ->selectRaw('min(start_date_local) as min, max(start_date_local) as max')
            ->first());
    }
}

<?php

namespace Filament\Tables\Columns\Concerns;

use Closure;
use Filament\Support\Contracts\HasIcon as IconInterface;
use Filament\Support\Enums\IconPosition;
use Filament\Tables\Columns\Column;

trait HasIcon
{
    protected string | bool | Closure | null $icon = null;

    protected IconPosition | string | Closure | null $iconPosition = null;

    public function icon(string | bool | Closure | null $icon): static
    {
        $this->icon = $icon;

        return $this;
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<mixed> | Closure  $icons
     */
    public function icons(array | Closure $icons): static
    {
        $this->icon(function (Column $column, $state) use ($icons) {
            $icons = $column->evaluate($icons);

            $icon = null;

            foreach ($icons as $conditionalIcon => $condition) {
                if (is_numeric($conditionalIcon)) {
                    $icon = $condition;
                } elseif ($condition instanceof Closure && $column->evaluate($condition)) {
                    $icon = $conditionalIcon;
                } elseif ($condition === $state) {
                    $icon = $conditionalIcon;
                }
            }

            return $icon;
        });

        return $this;
    }

    public function iconPosition(IconPosition | string | Closure | null $iconPosition): static
    {
        $this->iconPosition = $iconPosition;

        return $this;
    }

    public function getIcon(mixed $state): ?string
    {
        $icon = $this->evaluate($this->icon, [
            'state' => $state,
        ]);

        if ($icon === false) {
            return null;
        }

        if (filled($icon)) {
            return $icon;
        }

        if (! $state instanceof IconInterface) {
            return null;
        }

        return $state->getIcon();
    }

    public function getIconPosition(): IconPosition | string
    {
        return $this->evaluate($this->iconPosition) ?? IconPosition::Before;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Enums;

use Filament\Support\Colors\Color;
use Filament\Support\Contracts\HasColor;
use Filament\Support\Contracts\HasLabel;

/**
 * Valori del campo (deprecato ma ancora popolato) `type` dell'API Strava.
 * Elenco chiuso e documentato da Strava: nessun nuovo valore atteso.
 */
enum ActivityType: string implements HasColor, HasLabel
{
    case AlpineSki = 'AlpineSki';
    case BackcountrySki = 'BackcountrySki';
    case Canoeing = 'Canoeing';
    case Crossfit = 'Crossfit';
    case EBikeRide = 'EBikeRide';
    case Elliptical = 'Elliptical';
    case Golf = 'Golf';
    case Handcycle = 'Handcycle';
    case Hike = 'Hike';
    case IceSkate = 'IceSkate';
    case InlineSkate = 'InlineSkate';
    case Kayaking = 'Kayaking';
    case Kitesurf = 'Kitesurf';
    case NordicSki = 'NordicSki';
    case Ride = 'Ride';
    case RockClimbing = 'RockClimbing';
    case RollerSki = 'RollerSki';
    case Rowing = 'Rowing';
    case Run = 'Run';
    case Sail = 'Sail';
    case Skateboard = 'Skateboard';
    case Snowboard = 'Snowboard';
    case Snowshoe = 'Snowshoe';
    case Soccer = 'Soccer';
    case StairStepper = 'StairStepper';
    case StandUpPaddling = 'StandUpPaddling';
    case Surfing = 'Surfing';
    case Swim = 'Swim';
    case Velomobile = 'Velomobile';
    case VirtualRide = 'VirtualRide';
    case VirtualRun = 'VirtualRun';
    case Walk = 'Walk';
    case WeightTraining = 'WeightTraining';
    case Wheelchair = 'Wheelchair';
    case Windsurf = 'Windsurf';
    case Workout = 'Workout';
    case Yoga = 'Yoga';

    public function getLabel(): string
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::AlpineSki => 'Sci alpino',
            self::BackcountrySki => 'Sci fuoripista',
            self::Canoeing => 'Canoa',
            self::Crossfit => 'Crossfit',
            self::EBikeRide => 'E-bike',
            self::Elliptical => 'Ellittica',
            self::Golf => 'Golf',
            self::Handcycle => 'Handbike',
            self::Hike => 'Trekking',
            self::IceSkate => 'Pattinaggio su ghiaccio',
            self::InlineSkate => 'Pattini in linea',
            self::Kayaking => 'Kayak',
            self::Kitesurf => 'Kitesurf',
            self::NordicSki => 'Sci di fondo',
            self::Ride => 'Bici',
            self::RockClimbing => 'Arrampicata',
            self::RollerSki => 'Sci a rotelle',
            self::Rowing => 'Canottaggio',
            self::Run => 'Corsa',
            self::Sail => 'Vela',
            self::Skateboard => 'Skateboard',
            self::Snowboard => 'Snowboard',
            self::Snowshoe => 'Ciaspole',
            self::Soccer => 'Calcio',
            self::StairStepper => 'Stepper',
            self::StandUpPaddling => 'SUP',
            self::Surfing => 'Surf',
            self::Swim => 'Nuoto',
            self::Velomobile => 'Velomobile',
            self::VirtualRide => 'Bici virtuale',
            self::VirtualRun => 'Corsa virtuale',
            self::Walk => 'Camminata',
            self::WeightTraining => 'Pesi',
            self::Wheelchair => 'Carrozzina',
            self::Windsurf => 'Windsurf',
            self::Workout => 'Allenamento',
            self::Yoga => 'Yoga',
        };
    }

    /**
     * Colore per famiglia di sport. I tipi osservati nei dati reali
     * dell'app hanno ciascuno una tinta unica; i tipi mai visti finora
     * sono raggruppati per famiglia sulle tinte restanti.
     *
     * @return array{50: string, 100: string, 200: string, 300: string, 400: string, 500: string, 600: string, 700: string, 800: string, 900: string, 950: string}
     */
    public function getColor(): array
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::Run => Color::Orange,
            self::VirtualRun => Color::Amber,
            self::Ride => Color::Blue,
            self::Walk => Color::Green,
            self::Hike => Color::Emerald,
            self::EBikeRide => Color::Cyan,
            self::Snowboard => Color::Sky,
            self::NordicSki => Color::Indigo,
            self::Workout => Color::Violet,
            self::Golf => Color::Lime,
            self::Yoga => Color::Pink,

            self::VirtualRide, self::Velomobile, self::Handcycle => Color::Purple,

            self::Canoeing, self::Kayaking, self::Rowing, self::Sail,
            self::StandUpPaddling, self::Surfing, self::Swim,
            self::Kitesurf, self::Windsurf => Color::Teal,

            self::AlpineSki, self::BackcountrySki, self::RollerSki, self::IceSkate => Color::Yellow,

            self::Crossfit, self::Elliptical, self::StairStepper, self::WeightTraining => Color::Fuchsia,

            self::Soccer, self::Skateboard, self::InlineSkate,
            self::RockClimbing, self::Wheelchair => Color::Rose,

            self::Snowshoe => Color::Red,
        };
    }

    /**
     * Le attività a piedi si esprimono in passo (min/km), le altre in km/h.
     */
    public function getSpeedUnit(): SpeedUnit
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::Run, self::VirtualRun, self::Walk, self::Hike, self::Snowshoe => SpeedUnit::MinutesPerKilometer,
            default => SpeedUnit::KilometersPerHour,
        };
    }

    public function formatSpeed(?float $metersPerSecond): string
    {
        return $this->getSpeedUnit()->format($metersPerSecond);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Filament\Widgets;

use App\Enums\SpeedUnit;
use App\Models\Activity;
use Filament\Infolists\Components\Section;
use Filament\Infolists\Components\TextEntry;
use Filament\Infolists\Infolist;
use Filament\Tables;
use Filament\Tables\Actions\ViewAction;
use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Widgets\Concerns\InteractsWithPageFilters;
use Filament\Widgets\TableWidget as BaseWidget;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;

/**
 * Elenco paginato delle attività dell'utente loggato,
 * filtrato per il periodo selezionato in dashboard.
 */
class ActivitiesTableWidget extends BaseWidget
{
    use InteractsWithPageFilters;

    protected static ?string $heading = 'Attività';

    protected int|string|array $columnSpan = 'full';

    protected static ?int $sort = 1;

    public function table(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->query($this->getActivitiesQuery())
            ->defaultSort('start_date_local', 'desc')
            ->paginated([10, 25, 50, 100])
            ->defaultPaginationPageOption(10)
            ->columns([
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('start_date_local')
                    ->label('Data')
                    ->dateTime('d/m/Y H:i')
                    ->sortable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('name')
                    ->label('Nome')
                    ->searchable()
                    ->wrap(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('type')
                    ->label('Tipo')
                    // colore ed etichetta arrivano da ActivityType (HasColor/HasLabel)
                    ->badge()
                    ->sortable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('distance')
                    ->label('Distanza')
                    // i metri arrivano da Strava, li mostro in km
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?int $state): string => number_format(($state ?? 0) / 1000, 2, ',', '.').' km')
                    ->alignEnd()
                    ->sortable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('moving_time')
                    ->label('Tempo')
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?int $state): string => $this->formatDuration($state))
                    ->alignEnd()
                    ->sortable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('total_elevation_gain')
                    ->label('Dislivello')
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?int $state): string => number_format((int) $state, 0, ',', '.').' m')
                    ->alignEnd()
                    ->sortable()
                    ->toggleable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('average_speed')
                    ->label('Vel. media')
                    // unità dipendente dal tipo (passo per le attività a piedi, km/h per le altre)
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?float $state, Activity $record): string => $this->formatSpeed($state, $record))
                    ->alignEnd()
                    ->sortable()
                    ->toggleable(),
            ])
            ->actions([
                ViewAction::make()
                    ->slideOver()
                    ->infolist(fn (Infolist $infolist): Infolist => $infolist->schema([
                        Section::make()
                            ->columns(2)
                            ->schema([
                                TextEntry::make('name')
                                    ->label('Nome')
                                    ->columnSpanFull(),

                                TextEntry::make('type')
                                    ->label('Tipo')
                                    ->badge(),

                                TextEntry::make('start_date_local')
                                    ->label('Data e ora')
                                    ->dateTime('d/m/Y H:i'),

                                TextEntry::make('distance')
                                    ->label('Distanza')
                                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?int $state): string => number_format(($state ?? 0) / 1000, 2, ',', '.').' km'),

                                TextEntry::make('total_elevation_gain')
                                    ->label('Dislivello')
                                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?int $state): string => number_format((int) $state, 0, ',', '.').' m'),

                                TextEntry::make('moving_time')
                                    ->label('Tempo in movimento')
                                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?int $state): string => $this->formatDuration($state)),

                                TextEntry::make('elapsed_time')
                                    ->label('Tempo totale')
                                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?int $state): string => $this->formatDuration($state)),

                                TextEntry::make('average_speed')
                                    ->label('Vel. media')
                                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?float $state, Activity $record): string => $this->formatSpeed($state, $record)),

                                TextEntry::make('max_speed')
                                    ->label('Vel. massima')
                                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?float $state, Activity $record): string => $this->formatSpeed($state, $record)),

                                TextEntry::make('gear_id')
                                    ->label('Attrezzatura')
                                    ->placeholder('—'),

                                TextEntry::make('calories')
                                    ->label('Calorie')
                                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?float $state): ?string => $state ? number_format($state, 0, ',', '.').' kcal' : null)
                                    ->placeholder('—'),
                            ]),
                    ])),
            ]);
    }

    protected function getActivitiesQuery(): Builder
    {
        return Activity::query()
            ->where('user_id', auth()->id())
            ->when(
                $this->filters['startDate'] ?? null,
                fn (Builder $query, $date) => $query->whereDate('start_date_local', '>=', $date)
            )
            ->when(
                $this->filters['endDate'] ?? null,
                fn (Builder $query, $date) => $query->whereDate('start_date_local', '<=', $date)
            );
    }

    private function formatDuration(?int $seconds): string
    {
        $seconds ??= 0;

        return gmdate($seconds >= 3600 ? 'H:i:s' : 'i:s', $seconds);
    }

    private function formatSpeed(?float $metersPerSecond, ?Activity $record): string
    {
        return $record?->type?->formatSpeed($metersPerSecond)
            ?? SpeedUnit::KilometersPerHour->format($metersPerSecond);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Filament\Pages;

use App\Models\Activity;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Forms\Components\DatePicker;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use Filament\Forms\Form;
use Filament\Forms\Set;
use Filament\Pages\Dashboard as BaseDashboard;
use Filament\Pages\Dashboard\Concerns\HasFiltersForm;

/**
 * Dashboard con filtro per periodo, condiviso da tutti i widget.
 */
class Dashboard extends BaseDashboard
{
    use HasFiltersForm;

    /**
     * Filament applica il default di un campo solo al primissimo fill "da zero":
     * se la sessione contiene già un filtro esplicito (anche vuoto, salvato prima
     * che questi default esistessero), il default non scatta più. Qui forziamo
     * i valori pre-calcolati ogni volta che entrambi i campi risultano vuoti.
     */
    public function mount(): void
    {
        if (filled($this->filters['startDate'] ?? null) || filled($this->filters['endDate'] ?? null)) {
            return;
        }

        $range = $this->getUserActivitiesDateRange();

        $this->filters['startDate'] = $range->min;
        $this->filters['endDate'] = $range->max;

        $this->getFiltersForm()->fill($this->filters);

        if ($this->persistsFiltersInSession()) {
            session()->put($this->getFiltersSessionKey(), $this->filters);
        }
    }

    public function filtersForm(Form $form): Form
    {
        return $form
            ->schema([
                Select::make('preset')
                    ->label('Periodo rapido')
                    ->placeholder('Personalizzato')
                    ->options([
                        'all' => 'Tutte',
                        'current_week' => 'Settimana corrente',
                        'current_month' => 'Mese corrente',
                        'current_year' => 'Anno corrente',
                        'last_7_days' => 'Ultimi 7 giorni',
                        'last_30_days' => 'Ultimi 30 giorni',
                        'last_year' => 'Ultimo anno',
                    ])
                    ->live()
                    ->afterStateUpdated(function (?string $state, Set $set) {
                        if ($state === null) {
                            return;
                        }

                        [$start, $end] = $this->getPresetRange($state);

                        $set('startDate', $start);
                        $set('endDate', $end);
                    })
                    ->columnSpanFull(),

                DatePicker::make('startDate')
                    ->label('Data inizio')
                    ->default(fn () => $this->getUserActivitiesDateRange()->min)
                    ->maxDate(fn (callable $get) => $get('endDate') ?: now())
                    // modifica manuale = non è più uno dei preset rapidi
                    ->afterStateUpdated(fn (Set $set) => $set('preset', null))
                    ->live(),

                DatePicker::make('endDate')
                    ->label('Data fine')
                    ->default(fn () => $this->getUserActivitiesDateRange()->max)
                    ->minDate(fn (callable $get) => $get('startDate'))
                    ->maxDate(now())
                    ->afterStateUpdated(fn (Set $set) => $set('preset', null))
                    ->live()
                    ->suffixAction(
                        Action::make('reset')
                            ->label('Reimposta')
                            ->icon('heroicon-m-arrow-path')
                            ->action(function (Set $set) {
                                $range = $this->getUserActivitiesDateRange();

                                $set('preset', null);
                                $set('startDate', Carbon::parse($range->min)->toDateString());
                                $set('endDate', Carbon::parse($range->max)->toDateString());
                            }),
                        isInline: true,
                    ),
            ])
            ->columns(2);
    }

    /**
     * Estremi (data inizio, data fine) di un preset rapido.
     *
     * @return array{0: string, 1: string}
     */
    protected function getPresetRange(string $preset): array
    {
        $now = Carbon::now();

        return match ($preset) {
            'all' => [
                Carbon::parse($this->getUserActivitiesDateRange()->min)->toDateString(),
                Carbon::parse($this->getUserActivitiesDateRange()->max)->toDateString(),
            ],
            // la settimana comincia di domenica
            'current_week' => [
                $now->copy()->startOfWeek(Carbon::SUNDAY)->toDateString(),
                $now->copy()->startOfWeek(Carbon::SUNDAY)->addDays(6)->toDateString(),
            ],
            'current_month' => [
                $now->copy()->startOfMonth()->toDateString(),
                $now->copy()->endOfMonth()->toDateString(),
            ],
            'current_year' => [
                $now->copy()->startOfYear()->toDateString(),
                $now->copy()->endOfYear()->toDateString(),
            ],
            'last_7_days' => [
                $now->copy()->subDays(6)->toDateString(),
                $now->toDateString(),
            ],
            'last_30_days' => [
                $now->copy()->subDays(29)->toDateString(),
                $now->toDateString(),
            ],
            'last_year' => [
                $now->copy()->subYear()->addDay()->toDateString(),
                $now->toDateString(),
            ],
        };
    }

    /**
     * Data della prima e dell'ultima attività registrata dall'utente,
     * usate come estremi preimpostati del filtro periodo.
     */
    protected function getUserActivitiesDateRange(): object
    {
        return once(fn () => Activity::query()
            ->where('user_id', auth()->id())
            ->selectRaw('min(start_date_local) as min, max(start_date_local) as max')
            ->first());
    }
}

<?php

namespace Livewire;

use WeakMap;
use Livewire\Drawer\Utils;

class ComponentHookRegistry
{
    protected static $components;

    protected static $componentHooks = [];

    static function register($hook)
    {
        if (method_exists($hook, 'provide')) $hook::provide();

        if (in_array($hook, static::$componentHooks)) return;

        static::$componentHooks[] = $hook;
    }

    static function getHook($component, $hook)
    {
        if (! isset(static::$components[$component])) return;

        $componentHooks = static::$components[$component];

        foreach ($componentHooks as $componentHook) {
            if ($componentHook instanceof $hook) return $componentHook;
        }
    }

    static function boot()
    {
        static::$components = new WeakMap;

        foreach (static::$componentHooks as $hook) {
            on('mount', function ($component, $params, $key, $parent) use ($hook) {
                if (! $hook = static::initializeHook($hook, $component)) {
                    return;
                }

                $hook->callBoot();
                $hook->callMount($params, $parent);
            });

            on('hydrate', function ($component, $memo) use ($hook) {
                if (! $hook = static::initializeHook($hook, $component)) {
                    return;
                }

                $hook->callBoot();
                $hook->callHydrate($memo);
            });
        }

        on('update', function ($component, $fullPath, $newValue) {
            $propertyName = Utils::beforeFirstDot($fullPath);

            return static::proxyCallToHooks($component, 'callUpdate')($propertyName, $fullPath, $newValue);
        });

        on('call', function ($component, $method, $params, $addEffect, $earlyReturn) {
            return static::proxyCallToHooks($component, 'callCall')($method, $params, $earlyReturn);
        });

        on('render', function ($component, $view, $data) {
            return static::proxyCallToHooks($component, 'callRender')($view, $data);
        });

<?php

namespace Livewire\Features\SupportLifecycleHooks;

use function Livewire\store;
use function Livewire\wrap;
use Livewire\ComponentHook;

class SupportLifecycleHooks extends ComponentHook
{
    public function mount($params)
    {
        if (store($this->component)->has('skipMount')) { return; }

        $this->callHook('boot');
        $this->callTraitHook('boot');

        $this->callTraitHook('initialize');

        $this->callHook('mount', $params);
        $this->callTraitHook('mount', $params);

        $this->callHook('booted');
        $this->callTraitHook('booted');
    }

    public function hydrate()
    {
        if (store($this->component)->has('skipHydrate')) { return; }

        $this->callHook('boot');

<?php

namespace App\Filament\Pages;

use App\Models\Activity;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Forms\Components\DatePicker;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use Filament\Forms\Form;
use Filament\Forms\Set;
use Filament\Pages\Dashboard as BaseDashboard;
use Filament\Pages\Dashboard\Concerns\HasFiltersForm;

/**
 * Dashboard con filtro per periodo, condiviso da tutti i widget.
 */
class Dashboard extends BaseDashboard
{
    use HasFiltersForm;

    /**
     * Filament applica il default di un campo solo al primissimo fill "da zero":
     * se la sessione contiene già un filtro esplicito (anche vuoto, salvato prima
     * che questi default esistessero), il default non scatta più. Qui forziamo
     * i valori pre-calcolati ogni volta che entrambi i campi risultano vuoti.
     */
    public function mount(): void
    {
        if (filled($this->filters['startDate'] ?? null) || filled($this->filters['endDate'] ?? null)) {
            return;
        }

        $range = $this->getUserActivitiesDateRange();

        $this->filters['startDate'] = $range->min;
        $this->filters['endDate'] = $range->max;

        $this->getFiltersForm()->fill($this->filters);

        if ($this->persistsFiltersInSession()) {
            session()->put($this->getFiltersSessionKey(), $this->filters);
        }
    }

    public function filtersForm(Form $form): Form
    {
        return $form
            ->schema([
                Select::make('preset')
                    ->label('Periodo rapido')
                    ->placeholder('Personalizzato')
                    ->options([
                        'all' => 'Tutte',
                        'current_week' => 'Settimana corrente',
                        'current_month' => 'Mese corrente',
                        'current_year' => 'Anno corrente',
                        'last_7_days' => 'Ultimi 7 giorni',
                        'last_30_days' => 'Ultimi 30 giorni',
                        'last_year' => 'Ultimo anno',
                    ])
                    ->live()
                    ->afterStateUpdated(function (?string $state, Set $set) {
                        if ($state === null) {
                            return;
                        }

                        [$start, $end] = $this->getPresetRange($state);

                        $set('startDate', $start);
                        $set('endDate', $end);

                        // riportato a null subito dopo l'uso: se restasse valorizzato,
                        // riselezionare la stessa voce (es. da uno stato in sessione
                        // rimasto identico) non genererebbe un cambio di stato e il
                        // preset non verrebbe più riapplicato
                        $set('preset', null);
                    })
                    ->columnSpanFull(),

                DatePicker::make('startDate')
                    ->label('Data inizio')
                    ->default(fn () => $this->getUserActivitiesDateRange()->min)
                    ->maxDate(fn (callable $get) => $get('endDate') ?: now())
                    // modifica manuale = non è più uno dei preset rapidi
                    ->afterStateUpdated(fn (Set $set) => $set('preset', null))
                    ->live(),

                DatePicker::make('endDate')
                    ->label('Data fine')
                    ->default(fn () => $this->getUserActivitiesDateRange()->max)
                    ->minDate(fn (callable $get) => $get('startDate'))
                    ->maxDate(now())
                    ->afterStateUpdated(fn (Set $set) => $set('preset', null))
                    ->live()
                    ->suffixAction(
                        Action::make('reset')
                            ->label('Reimposta')
                            ->icon('heroicon-m-arrow-path')
                            ->action(function (Set $set) {
                                $range = $this->getUserActivitiesDateRange();

                                $set('preset', null);
                                $set('startDate', Carbon::parse($range->min)->toDateString());
                                $set('endDate', Carbon::parse($range->max)->toDateString());
                            }),
                        isInline: true,
                    ),
            ])
            ->columns(2);
    }

    /**
     * Estremi (data inizio, data fine) di un preset rapido.
     *
     * @return array{0: string, 1: string}
     */
    protected function getPresetRange(string $preset): array
    {
        $now = Carbon::now();

        return match ($preset) {
            'all' => [
                Carbon::parse($this->getUserActivitiesDateRange()->min)->toDateString(),
                Carbon::parse($this->getUserActivitiesDateRange()->max)->toDateString(),
            ],
            // la settimana comincia di domenica
            'current_week' => [
                $now->copy()->startOfWeek(Carbon::SUNDAY)->toDateString(),
                $now->copy()->startOfWeek(Carbon::SUNDAY)->addDays(6)->toDateString(),
            ],
            'current_month' => [
                $now->copy()->startOfMonth()->toDateString(),
                $now->copy()->endOfMonth()->toDateString(),
            ],
            'current_year' => [
                $now->copy()->startOfYear()->toDateString(),
                $now->copy()->endOfYear()->toDateString(),
            ],
            'last_7_days' => [
                $now->copy()->subDays(6)->toDateString(),
                $now->toDateString(),
            ],
            'last_30_days' => [
                $now->copy()->subDays(29)->toDateString(),
                $now->toDateString(),
            ],
            'last_year' => [
                $now->copy()->subYear()->addDay()->toDateString(),
                $now->toDateString(),
            ],
        };
    }

    /**
     * Data della prima e dell'ultima attività registrata dall'utente,
     * usate come estremi preimpostati del filtro periodo.
     */
    protected function getUserActivitiesDateRange(): object
    {
        return once(fn () => Activity::query()
            ->where('user_id', auth()->id())
            ->selectRaw('min(start_date_local) as min, max(start_date_local) as max')
            ->first());
    }
}

content.text: Ora rifaccio i test cruciali: sessione con date personalizzate deve sopravvivere a un reload; sessione vuota deve ancora ricevere i default; e il caso originale del preset "Tutte" deve continuare a funzionare.

Tutti e quattro i casi si comportano correttamente adesso:

1. **Date personalizzate reali in sessione** → sopravvivono al reload (prima venivano cancellate, questo era il bug più grave).
2. **Prima visita (sessione vuota)** → riceve i default (prima e ultima attività).
3. **Stato "bloccato" (entrambi i campi vuoti)** → riceve comunque i default.
4. **Preset "Tutte" già in sessione, poi riselezionato** → ora funziona (prima non succedeva nulla perché il valore non cambiava).

**Modifica:** [app/Filament/Pages/Dashboard.php](app/Filament/Pages/Dashboard.php#L18-L47)
- Sostituito il `mount()` esplicito (che Livewire chiama **prima** del hook `mountHasFilters()` del trait Filament, quindi vedeva sempre lo stato ancora vuoto e sovrascriveva ogni personalizzazione ad ogni reload) con un override diretto di `mountHasFilters()`, che invoca prima il comportamento originale del trait (`baseMountHasFilters()`, alias impostato nel `use HasFiltersForm { ... }`) e solo dopo applica i default se i campi risultano ancora vuoti.
- Il fix del preset "Tutte" aggiunto prima (reset di `preset` a `null` dopo l'uso) resta valido e ora si combina correttamente con questo.

Questo era un bug più subdolo di quanto sembrasse dalla tua domanda: non era solo "Tutte" a non resettare, ma **qualsiasi filtro personalizzato veniva silenziosamente cancellato ad ogni reload della dashboard**. Grazie per averlo segnalato.

<?php

namespace App\Filament\Widgets;

use App\Enums\SpeedUnit;
use App\Models\Activity;
use Filament\Infolists\Components\Section;
use Filament\Infolists\Components\TextEntry;
use Filament\Infolists\Infolist;
use Filament\Tables;
use Filament\Tables\Actions\ViewAction;
use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Filament\Widgets\Concerns\InteractsWithPageFilters;
use Filament\Widgets\TableWidget as BaseWidget;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;

/**
 * Elenco paginato delle attività dell'utente loggato,
 * filtrato per il periodo selezionato in dashboard.
 */
class ActivitiesTableWidget extends BaseWidget
{
    use InteractsWithPageFilters;

    protected static ?string $heading = 'Attività';

    protected int|string|array $columnSpan = 'full';

    protected static ?int $sort = 1;

    public function table(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->query($this->getActivitiesQuery())
            ->defaultSort('start_date_local', 'desc')
            ->paginated([10, 25, 50, 100])
            ->defaultPaginationPageOption(10)
            ->columns([
                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('start_date_local')
                    ->label('Data')
                    ->dateTime('d/m/Y H:i')
                    ->sortable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('name')
                    ->label('Nome')
                    ->searchable()
                    ->wrap(),

                Tables\Columns\IconColumn::make('type')
                    ->label('Tipo')
                    // icona e colore arrivano da ActivityType (HasIcon/HasColor), l'etichetta va nel tooltip
                    ->tooltip(fn (?Activity $record): ?string => $record?->type?->getLabel())
                    ->sortable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('distance')
                    ->label('Distanza')
                    // i metri arrivano da Strava, li mostro in km
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?int $state): string => number_format(($state ?? 0) / 1000, 2, ',', '.').' km')
                    ->alignEnd()
                    ->sortable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('moving_time')
                    ->label('Tempo')
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?int $state): string => $this->formatDuration($state))
                    ->alignEnd()
                    ->sortable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('total_elevation_gain')
                    ->label('Dislivello')
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?int $state): string => number_format((int) $state, 0, ',', '.').' m')
                    ->alignEnd()
                    ->sortable()
                    ->toggleable(),

                Tables\Columns\TextColumn::make('average_speed')
                    ->label('Vel. media')
                    // unità dipendente dal tipo (passo per le attività a piedi, km/h per le altre)
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?float $state, Activity $record): string => $this->formatSpeed($state, $record))
                    ->alignEnd()
                    ->sortable()
                    ->toggleable(),
            ])
            ->actions([
                ViewAction::make()
                    ->slideOver()
                    ->infolist(fn (Infolist $infolist): Infolist => $infolist->schema([
                        Section::make()
                            ->columns(2)
                            ->schema([
                                TextEntry::make('name')
                                    ->label('Nome')
                                    ->columnSpanFull(),

                                TextEntry::make('type')
                                    ->label('Tipo')
                                    ->badge(),

                                TextEntry::make('start_date_local')
                                    ->label('Data e ora')
                                    ->dateTime('d/m/Y H:i'),

                                TextEntry::make('distance')
                                    ->label('Distanza')
                                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?int $state): string => number_format(($state ?? 0) / 1000, 2, ',', '.').' km'),

                                TextEntry::make('total_elevation_gain')
                                    ->label('Dislivello')
                                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?int $state): string => number_format((int) $state, 0, ',', '.').' m'),

                                TextEntry::make('moving_time')
                                    ->label('Tempo in movimento')
                                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?int $state): string => $this->formatDuration($state)),

                                TextEntry::make('elapsed_time')
                                    ->label('Tempo totale')
                                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?int $state): string => $this->formatDuration($state)),

                                TextEntry::make('average_speed')
                                    ->label('Vel. media')
                                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?float $state, Activity $record): string => $this->formatSpeed($state, $record)),

                                TextEntry::make('max_speed')
                                    ->label('Vel. massima')
                                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?float $state, Activity $record): string => $this->formatSpeed($state, $record)),

                                TextEntry::make('gear_id')
                                    ->label('Attrezzatura')
                                    ->placeholder('—'),

                                TextEntry::make('calories')
                                    ->label('Calorie')
                                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (?float $state): ?string => $state ? number_format($state, 0, ',', '.').' kcal' : null)
                                    ->placeholder('—'),
                            ]),
                    ])),
            ]);
    }

    protected function getActivitiesQuery(): Builder
    {
        return Activity::query()
            ->where('user_id', auth()->id())
            ->when(
                $this->filters['startDate'] ?? null,
                fn (Builder $query, $date) => $query->whereDate('start_date_local', '>=', $date)
            )
            ->when(
                $this->filters['endDate'] ?? null,
                fn (Builder $query, $date) => $query->whereDate('start_date_local', '<=', $date)
            );
    }

    private function formatDuration(?int $seconds): string
    {
        $seconds ??= 0;

        return gmdate($seconds >= 3600 ? 'H:i:s' : 'i:s', $seconds);
    }

    private function formatSpeed(?float $metersPerSecond, ?Activity $record): string
    {
        return $record?->type?->formatSpeed($metersPerSecond)
            ?? SpeedUnit::KilometersPerHour->format($metersPerSecond);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Livewire\Features\SupportReactiveProps;

use Livewire\Features\SupportAttributes\Attribute as LivewireAttribute;
use function Livewire\store;

#[\Attribute]
class BaseReactive extends LivewireAttribute
{
    function __construct() {}

    protected $originalValueHash;

    public function mount($params)
    {
        $property = $this->getName();

        store($this->component)->push('reactiveProps', $property);

        $this->originalValueHash = crc32(json_encode($this->getValue()));
    }

    public function hydrate()
    {
        if (SupportReactiveProps::hasPassedInProps($this->component->getId())) {
            $updatedValue = SupportReactiveProps::getPassedInProp(
                $this->component->getId(), $this->getName()
            );

            $this->setValue($updatedValue);
        }

        $this->originalValueHash = crc32(json_encode($this->getValue()));
    }

    public function dehydrate($context)
    {
        if ($this->originalValueHash !== crc32(json_encode($this->getValue()))) {
            throw new CannotMutateReactivePropException($this->component->getName(), $this->getName());
        }

        $context->pushMemo('props', $this->getName());
    }
}

Prova a verificarlo nel browser: pagina la tabella, poi cambia data inizio/fine (o un preset) e controlla che torni a pagina 1.
